label: concernsRisk
definition: Links a Risk Register Entry or Scenario Description to the Risk it concerns.
formal_home_candidate: OWL object property + SHACL local constraints
temporal_semantics: Reference may persist across record versions; relation itself can be version-scoped.
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact multiplicity depends on register policy; do not make functional globally.

label: describesScenario
definition: Links a Scenario Description to the Risk Scenario it describes.
temporal_semantics: Descriptions/version histories may change while scenario identity is retained.
conflicts_uncertainty: Do not infer description = scenario.

label: realizedAs
definition: Links a Risk Scenario to a realized Risk Event when realization evidence exists.
formal_home_candidate: OWL object property; rule only if realization criteria formalized
temporal_semantics: Requires occurrence/time evidence; absence of event does not negate scenario.
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact modal semantics require #25.

label: hasConsequence
definition: Links a Risk Event or Risk Scenario to a Consequence.
formal_home_candidate: OWL object property + SHACL; causality guarded
temporal_semantics: Consequence occurrence may be time-scoped and uncertain for scenarios.
conflicts_uncertainty: Must not imply causal certainty from mere association.

label: hasRiskSource
definition: Links a Risk or Risk Scenario to a Risk Source considered relevant.
conflicts_uncertainty: Source relation is weaker than causal relation by default.

label: predisposedBy
definition: Links a Risk Scenario/Event context to a Predisposing Condition.
formal_home_candidate: OWL object property; causal rules deferred
conflicts_uncertainty: Not equivalent to cause.

label: triggeredBy
definition: Links a Risk Event or process transition to a Trigger.
formal_home_candidate: OWL relation + rule/SHACL only if operationalized
temporal_semantics: Trigger may be event- or threshold-based and time-indexed.
conflicts_uncertainty: Do not infer trigger = cause universally.

label: causes
definition: Asserts causal dependence supported by explicit evidence/model assumptions.
formal_home_candidate: OWL object property only for asserted causality; rule/provenance annotation required
temporal_semantics: Causal assertions should be evidence/version/context scoped.
conflicts_uncertainty: Never inferred merely from sequence/dependency.

label: associatedWith
definition: Represents non-causal association/dependency between risk-relevant entities.
symmetry_candidate: candidate yes only for generic association
conflicts_uncertainty: Symmetry only for generic association, not directed dependency; formal split may be needed.

label: affects
definition: Links Risk/Event/Consequence to an externally owned Objective, Capability, Process or Risk Subject.
temporal_semantics: Effect may be anticipated vs realized; distinction may need subrelations.
conflicts_uncertainty: Potential vs realized effect semantics require care.

label: exposes
definition: Links a Risk Source/Condition to a Risk Subject under a relevant context.
conflicts_uncertainty: Financial/physical exposure refinements remain profile-level.

label: hasVulnerability
definition: Links a Risk Subject/context to a Vulnerability.
temporal_semantics: Vulnerability may exist during an interval and change.
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact bearer/category requires #25.

label: performedAssessmentOf
definition: Links a Risk Assessment Activity to the Risk/context assessed.
formal_home_candidate: OWL object property + SHACL local minCount candidate
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact min cardinality belongs to #26/SHACL.

label: usesAssessmentMethod
definition: Links an assessment activity to its method.
conflicts_uncertainty: Multi-method assessments possible; do not make functional globally.

label: producesAssessmentResult
definition: Links an assessment activity to a produced assessment result.
temporal_semantics: Result inherits assessment time/context only via explicit relation, not identity.
conflicts_uncertainty: No process/result collapse.

label: assessmentResultConcerns
definition: Links an assessment result to the Risk/context it evaluates.
temporal_semantics: Result validity should be time/context scoped.
conflicts_uncertainty: One result may concern a compound context; exact semantics later.

label: supportedByEvidence
definition: Links an assessment/result/assertion to Evidence Item(s).
conflicts_uncertainty: Evidence role is contextual, not intrinsic class identity.

label: generatedByObservation
definition: Links an Observation Result to its Observation Activity.
temporal_semantics: Observation time belongs to activity/result provenance.
conflicts_uncertainty: Functionality only local hypothesis.

label: hasProvenance
definition: Links an artifact/result/assertion to provenance information.
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact PROV-O predicates chosen in #21/#26.

label: qualifiedByConfidence
definition: Links assessment/evidence result to Assessment Confidence/uncertainty information.
temporal_semantics: Confidence may vary by method/time/evidence set.
conflicts_uncertainty: Confidence/uncertainty exact representation unresolved.

label: selectsTreatmentStrategy
definition: Links a risk-management decision/context to a Risk Treatment Strategy.
conflicts_uncertainty: Decision event concept may need explicit representation in #25.

label: planImplementsStrategy
definition: Links a Risk Treatment Plan to a Treatment Strategy.
conflicts_uncertainty: No global cardinality.

label: activityExecutesPlan
definition: Links a Risk Treatment Activity to the Plan it executes.
temporal_semantics: Activity has execution time; plans may span many activities.
conflicts_uncertainty: Plan can exist without execution.

label: activityUsesControl
definition: Links a Risk Treatment Activity to a Control Mechanism it deploys/uses.
conflicts_uncertainty: Control may preexist the activity; no identity collapse.

label: controlProtects
definition: Links a Control Mechanism to a Risk Subject/Objective/Process it protects or modifies.
temporal_semantics: Effectiveness can vary over time and should be assessed separately.
conflicts_uncertainty: Do not equate presence of control with effectiveness.

label: hasRiskOwner
definition: Derived material relation linking a Risk/managed record context to an external Actor who plays the Risk Owner role, truthmade by a Risk Responsibility assignment.
formal_home_candidate: derived OWL property or query/rule; not a primitive role-instance link
conflicts_uncertainty: Replaces prior `bearsRiskOwnerRole` shorthand because Risk Owner is a role type, not a role individual.

label: assignsResponsibilityFor
definition: Links Risk Responsibility/assignment to the relevant Risk/artifact/obligation.
temporal_semantics: Assignments can have validity intervals and reassignment history.
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact accountability vs responsibility specialization pending.

label: responsibilityAssignedTo
definition: Links a Risk Responsibility assignment to the Actor/Role bearer.
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact actor ontology external.

label: registerContainsEntry
definition: Links a Risk Register to its Risk Register Entries.
conflicts_uncertainty: No inference that register contains actual Risk phenomena.

label: hasWorkflowState
definition: Links a managed record/process to Workflow State.
formal_home_candidate: OWL current relation + history pattern; SHACL/rules for workflow
temporal_semantics: Current vs historical states must be time-indexed.
conflicts_uncertainty: Closed must not imply Risk State cessation.

label: hasRiskState
definition: Links a Risk/context to Risk State.
cardinality_candidate: 1 current at defined context; historical many
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact state bearer/category requires #25.

label: precedesState
definition: Links a historical state to a later state within the same state dimension.
transitivity_candidate: candidate transitive only as temporal order
formal_home_candidate: Prefer time ontology relation; rules not universal
conflicts_uncertainty: Never use across Risk State vs Workflow State indiscriminately.

label: supersedesAssessmentResult
definition: Links a newer assessment result to an older result it supersedes for a stated context.
temporal_semantics: Requires timestamps/context; superseded result remains historical evidence.
conflicts_uncertainty: Do not delete/replace old result semantically.

label: basedOnPriorAssessment
definition: Links a reassessment activity to prior assessment/result context used as input.
conflicts_uncertainty: Not every assessment is reassessment.

label: hasIndicator
definition: Links a Risk/context/process to an Indicator used for monitoring.
temporal_semantics: Indicator definition/version may change over time.
conflicts_uncertainty: No claim that indicator is observation result itself.

label: hasThreshold
definition: Links an Indicator/Assessment Method/Risk Criteria to a Threshold.
formal_home_candidate: SHACL/data/rule placement likely; not OWL universal truth
conflicts_uncertainty: Not Core by default.

label: pharmaEntityInRiskContext
definition: Links a SemRisk Risk/Scenario/Event/etc. to a CM-PharmE-owned Pharma entity relevant to the case.
range_candidate: SR-CPT-040 or other CM-PharmE external entity
conflicts_uncertainty: Exact bridge predicates finalized in #5/#21.

label: profileExtendsCoreConcept
definition: Records that a profile-specific semantic construct refines a reusable Core concept without changing Core identity.
formal_home_candidate: mapping/governance artifact rather than domain OWL by default
conflicts_uncertainty: May remain registry/mapping relation, not ontology property.
